CBS canceled two recent scripted series and set their final air dates ahead of its April 15 schedule reveal, clarifying near-term programming plans. According to Deadline, the CBS cancellations affect Watson and DMV, with finales slated for May 3 and May 11, respectively. These finale dates close out Watson’s second season and end DMV after one season, positioning CBS for its 2026–27 lineup decisions.
CBS renewed 12 dramas, including Marshals, CIA, Sheriff Country, and Boston Blue, and added Cupertino and Einstein. The network is also considering new comedies Eternally Yours and Tillbrooks. The moves follow months of uncertainty for two of CBS’s lowest-rated shows. | ComingSoon | Facebook

He noted Robert Downey Jr.’s post-Marvel resurgence and said the multiverse permits the iconic hero to return as an iconic villain. Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to premiere on December 18, 2026, with Avengers: Secret Wars set for December 17, 2027.ComingSoon965 views · 1d ago1:26Selena Gomez is attached to star in Brady Corbet’s next feature, a reported four-hour, X-rated project, according to The InSneider’s Jeff Sneider.
